subject: Marketplace listing technical checklist & co-sell dependencies
messages:
From: Mike Chen <mike@cloudpartnersol.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: natalie@cp-solutions.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing & co-sell — prerequisites

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking this on. CloudPartner Solutions is moving forward with listing Redwood Inference on AWS and GCP marketplaces as part of our joint offering. Before we kick off the portal work, can you share a short technical checklist of what Redwood needs to provide (artifacts, images, seller account mapping, sample SaaS packaging, pricing metadata)?

Two specific asks from our onboarding team:
- Do you have an official SOC 2 excerpt we can attach to the partner profile?
- Is there a lightweight architecture diagram we can expose on the public listing (no customer data, just infra)?

We'd like to align on timeline: goal is to have listings submitted within three weeks if we can gather materials this week. Can you point me to the right folks for the technical handoff and who will own co-sell enablement items?

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a quick call.

Best,
Mike Chen
Partner Success Manager
CloudPartner Solutions
--
attachments: none (initial email)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Mike Chen <mike@cloudpartnersol.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing & co-sell — prerequisites

Mike —

Thanks for the clear asks. I've attached our working checklist (marketplace_listing_checklist.xlsx) with the items you mentioned. High level:

- Technical artifacts: lightweight architecture diagram (redwood_architecture_v1.png), public TLS cert info, API endpoint pattern, supported models and recommended instance sizes.
- Compliance: SOC2 excerpt (we'll provide a redacted PDF), data handling summary, and a short MSA excerpt for listing.
- Packaging: container images for private marketplace bundles, parameters for service-level metadata, and test credentials.
- Billing/pricing: SKU mapping per cloud (we'll provide a mapping table in the sheet).

Next steps I recommend:
1) Schedule a 30-min tech-handoff with Sean (copied) — he owns our integration packaging.
2) Marissa will lead co-sell enablement and GTM assets.
3) Vanessa to confirm legal / partner portal mapping and whether we need an AWS Partner Central subscription upgrade.

Sean — can you take point on a short runbook for the portal uploads and confirm any artifact size limits?

On timelines: if we get the SOC2 excerpt and diagram by Monday (6/15), we can target a submission to AWS and GCP by 6/21.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
--
attachments: marketplace_listing_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Quick additions from the GTM/co-sell side:

- Co-sell prerequisites: joint sell playbook, 2 case studies (one SMB, one enterprise), standardized one-pager, and a list of pre-approved discount tiers for co-sell registration.
- Sales enablement: training slot for partner AE teams (30 minutes), technical FAQs for marketplace customers, and a one-click lead routing webhook (we'll need the endpoint).
- Legal & procurement: vendor code + contact for procurement (we'll coordinate the PO flow).

Linking our partner portal guidance here: https://partners.aws.amazon.com/console/partner/xxxx123 — please review the required fields in the "Listing Details" section (logo sizes, short/long descriptions, support contacts).

Mike — if you can share the contact for the partner portal intake team at CloudPartner, we'll align deadlines. I'll start drafting the playbook and template one-pager and drop a DocuSign for the co-sell registration form (link below).

DocuSign (draft co-sell reg): https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABCDEFG

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
